SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 13:51:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

        a.close_cad_latest,
        a.currency

        market.cppib_market_equity_pricing_aggregation AS a

        market.qsrp_market_exchange_rate AS f
        ON a.currency = f.currency AND a.pricing_date = f.data_date

        market.qsrp_market_exchange_rate AS g   ON a.pricing_date = g.data_date and f.vendor = g.vendor

        f.vendor = 'wm'
        AND g.currency = 'CAD'
        AND a.pricing_date= date'2025-06-16'

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 05:18:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-17'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-17'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 21:06:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

    business_date,
    ticker,
    coalesce(( SELECT 'Y'
FROM
    holdings.scd_holdings_main hld
WHERE
    hld.cppib_sec_id = CAST(id_cppibsec AS VARCHAR)
    AND ( try_cast ( hld.abor_maturity_date AS DATE ) > current_date - INTERVAL '5' DAY OR ( hld.abor_maturity_date IS NULL ) ) ),
'N' ) as in_scdholding
FROM
    df_trusted_prod.mds_csl_daily_history
WHERE
    id_cppibsec IN (
        SELECT
            id_cppibsec
        FROM
            df_trusted_prod.mds_csl_daily_history csl,
            reference.scd_securities sec
        WHERE
            sec.cppib_sec_id = CAST(csl.id_cppibsec AS VARCHAR)
            AND csl.business_date IN (DATE ( '2025-06-13' ), DATE ( '2025-06-16' ))
                AND csl.id_bb_unique IS NOT NULL
                    AND sec.abor_instrument_type_id > ' '
                        AND sec.abor_instrument_type_id NOT IN ('ALM','Bank account','Cash bucket','Index security')
                            AND sec.abor_security_id NOT LIKE ( 'XXX%' )
                                AND sec.bloomberg_unique_id NOT LIKE ( '%NULL%' )
                                    AND sec.bloomberg_unique_id NOT LIKE ( 'SS%' )
        GROUP BY csl.id_cppibsec
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT csl.ticker) > 1
    )
    AND business_date IN (DATE ( '2025-06-13' ),DATE ( '2025-06-16' ))
        AND id_bb_unique IS NOT NULL                                
                                order BY 1,2

WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-16'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.gics_sector='Financials' and f.business_date = ule.business_date
         --and ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit is not null-- and ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit != -1

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.acpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-16'
group by ule.gics_sector, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(acpp_credit_exposure) desc

        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,

    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

-- Query # 11 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 11 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined'

/* cppi::e987e2affbf61b314be75616c2b09de3b223fccaf3369792530fbfd81940c69d */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 10:23:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 16 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 17 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-16 23:58:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight 48fa4e54-3347-43a2-b52b-38661b1f499d */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

    red_code as index_red_code,
    MIN(business_date) as trading_start_date,
    MAX(business_date) as trading_end_date,
    index_name as index_ticker,
    index_series as series,
    index_version as version,
    index_term as tenor

    1=1

    AND index_term in ('5Y')

    SELECT MAX(df_meta_run_date) AS max_run_date

    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I667D'

/* cppi::c5ecfbbcf988a182922579c5aa70f1c0a9b502984720e97d787f19684294df7b */
WITH
earliest_business_date_of_given_month AS (
    SELECT MIN(business_date) AS business_date
    FROM market_uat.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE rate_type_code = 'SR'
        AND MONTH(business_date) = MONTH(DATE('2025-06-17'))
        AND YEAR(business_date) = YEAR(DATE('2025-06-17'))
),
fx_rates_usd_to_cad AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_uat.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND to_currency = 'CAD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_usd_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        from_currency from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_uat.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_cad_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        usd_to_cl.business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        ROUND((usd_to_cad.exchange_rate / usd_to_cl.exchange_rate), 8) exchange_rate
    FROM
        (fx_rates_usd_to_local usd_to_cl
        INNER JOIN fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad ON (usd_to_cl.business_date = usd_to_cad.business_date))
    UNION
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        'USD' to_currency,
        exchange_rate exchange_rate
    FROM
        fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad
)
SELECT
    business_date,
    from_currency,
    to_currency,
    exchange_rate
FROM fx_rates_cad_to_local
WHERE business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM earliest_business_date_of_given_month)

/* QuickSight 9e837dd6-b896-4e07-8b95-c5f2eabcc763 */
SELECT "business_date", "vendor", "base_currency", "to_currency", "is_exchange_holiday_flag", "exchange_rate"
FROM (with original_data as (
	select
		  data_date as business_date
		, vendor
		, 'CAD' as base_currency
		, currency as to_currency
		, is_exchange_holiday_flag
		, exchange_rate
	from
		market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
	where
		currency != 'CAD'
), inverse_data as (
	select
		  data_date as business_date
		, vendor
		, currency as base_currency
		, 'CAD' as to_currency
		, is_exchange_holiday_flag
		, 1 / exchange_rate as exchange_rate
	from
		market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
	where
		currency != 'CAD'
), combined_data_clean as (
	select *
	from (
		select * from original_data
		union all
		select * from inverse_data
	)
	where exchange_rate is not null 
)
select * from combined_data_clean) AS "finsights_markets_fx_cad"

SELECT 
 	InvestmentStructureLevel4,
    business_date,
    model_portfolio_code,

    security_id,
    security_no,
    market_value_cad,
    market_value_qc,
    fx_rate_quotation_to_portfolio,
    pnl_cad,
    row_type

    FROM performance.pace_holding_pnl ph

        ON ph.model_portfolio_code = mp.model_portfolio_id
        AND CAST(ph.business_date AS VARCHAR) = mp.business_date

        ON CAST(ph.business_date AS VARCHAR) = inv.business_date
        AND ph.model_portfolio_code = inv.model_portfolio
        AND inv.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    WHERE ph.business_date = DATE '2025-06-16'

    	inv.InvestmentStructureLevel4,
        ph.business_date,

        mp.model_portfolio_name

    UNION ALL

    -- Detail rows
    SELECT 
    	inv.InvestmentStructureLevel4,
        ph.business_date,
        ph.model_portfolio_code,

        ph.security_id,

/* cppi::3a2de9f8af87dc8604468c36b6739a17f0a8a06c252db69291d8e2c98af632d8 */
SELECT * from (
            SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
                format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot')
            UNION
            SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
                format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
            Left Join ( 
                SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
                FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            ) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
            WHERE MainTable.business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date, from_currency )
    where from_currency = 'USD'

 FROM (

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime

			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs

		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency

                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency

       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-14')

         perf_data.bloomberg_code

/* cppi::716bd7615c3ad8f845eb225f9b28f19baf5373ba5c4ad9f6ff6440fd95d4eaea */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-16'
    )
select ule.party_name,
       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) *
                                                                100, 1)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit)
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit is not null and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit != -1 and f.business_date = ule.business_date

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-16'
group by ule.party_name, ule.gics_sector, ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc

    '' AS id,

/* QuickSight 39a7e0b0-3e30-4f2e-96d9-476fe5a897e3 */
SELECT "business_date" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.business_date", "node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.node", "PV" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.PV", "10 Year Volatility" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Volatility", "10 Year VaR" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year VaR", "10 Year Expected Shortfall" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Expected Shortfall", "var_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.var_pct", "vol_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.vol_pct", "cvar_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.cvar_pct", "strategy_node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.strategy_node"
FROM (-- Step 1: Get program-level metrics
WITH program_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
    program AS node,

    -- Base values
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) AS PV,
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Volatility",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year VaR",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Expected Shortfall",

    -- % Calculations (with null and zero checks)
    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS var_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS vol_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cvar_pct

  FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  WHERE program IN ('Listed Real Estate', 'Listed Infrastructure', 'Listed SEG')
    AND hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    AND portfolio_type = 'IP'
    AND hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
    AND (
          analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
          OR (
             analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
             AND confidence_level = 0.95
          )
        )
    AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE '2023-06-30'
  GROUP BY CAST(business_date AS DATE), program
)

-- Step 2: Add strategy_node manually
SELECT 
  pd.*,
  CASE
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Real Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Infrastructure' THEN 'Infrastructure'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed SEG' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strategy_node
FROM program_data pd) AS "LRA- Radar Analytics"

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 20:48:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
